content:
Pleased to have appeared for Respondent before the Hon’ble Patna High Court.
The matter involved a land/tenancy dispute concerning rent receipts and proceedings under the Bihar Privileged Persons Homestead Tenancy Act, 1947.
The Hon’ble Court, permitted the petitioner to approach the Collector, Madhepura, for appropriate consideration in accordance with law.
comment: In tenancy matters, the evidentiary value of long-standing revenue records often becomes as important as the statutory provisions. Careful preservation of documents and timely challenges can shape the outcome significantly.
